15-3-41.

Strike at Incense & Candle Stores.
315 Avenue Road & 360 Simsa Road.

At 4:10 p.m. on the 15-3-41., the complainant Ma
Zang Yien (馬尚賢), proprietor of the Kyung Ting Cha
(金鼎高) Incense & Candle Store, 315 Avenue Road,
reported at the station that at 4 p.m. even date, some
twenty unknown male Chinese entered his shop and
succeeded in persuading 12 of his shop salesmen to
strike for higher pay.

Complainant employs only the twelve strikers and
stated that at 4 p.m. even date, the twenty intruders
entered his shop and stated that they were similarly
employed in other shops and were on strike for higher
pay, and exhorted complainant's staff to join the strike.
His staff of twelve then stopped work and
accompanied the strikers from the shop.

Two of the complainant's staff named Sung Chihun
Sung (陳乾順) and Sun Jun (朱英) returned at 5:15
p.m. even date, and resumed work, stating that they
had evaded the others on Moshan Road, but were unaware
of the destination of the strikers.

The complainant stated that he was afraid owing
of discontent among his employees who had demanded
an increase of wages for months.

No person was arrested or detained nor have we any

1941年3月15日。

香烛店罢工。
爱文义路315号及 Simsa 路360号。

1941年3月15日下午4时10分，爱文义路315号金鼎高（Kyung Ting Cha）香烛店店主马尚贤（馬尚賢）向捕房报案称，当日下午4时，约二十名身份不明的中国男子进入其店内，成功说服其12名店员为要求加薪而罢工。

投诉人仅雇佣这十二名罢工者，并称当日下午4时，这二十名闯入者进入其店内，声称他们受雇于其他店铺，正为加薪而罢工，并鼓动投诉人的员工加入罢工。随后，其十二名员工停止工作，随罢工者离开店铺。

投诉人的两名员工，名为陈乾顺（Sung Chihun Sung）和朱英（Sun Jun），于当日下午5时15分返回并复工，称他们在莫山路（Moshan Road）避开了其他人，但不知罢工者的去向。

投诉人称，由于员工数月来一直要求加薪，他对此感到担忧。

无人被捕或被拘留，我们也无任何

1 (第1页)

香烛店罢工。
爱文义路315号及新闸路360号。

1941年3月15日下午4时10分，爱文义路315号金鼎茶（Kyung Ting Cha）香烛店店主马尚贤（馬尚賢）向捕房报案称，当日下午4时，约二十名身份不明的中国男子进入其店内，成功说服其12名店员为要求加薪而罢工。

投诉人仅雇佣这十二名罢工者，并称当日下午4时，这二十名闯入者进入其店内，声称他们受雇于其他店铺，正为加薪而罢工，并鼓动投诉人的员工加入罢工。随后，其十二名员工停止工作，随罢工者离开店铺。

投诉人的两名员工，名为陈乾顺（Zung Chien Sung）和朱芬（Tsu Fan），于当日下午5时15分返回并复工，称他们在纳森路（Nathan Road）避开了其他人，但不知罢工者的去向。

投诉人称，他首次意识到员工中存在不满情绪是在1941年3月13日他们要求加薪时。

他支付给每人的平均工资为80.00美元

REPORT ON STRIKE
"B" Division
Sinza Station (Misc. 136/41.) April 4, 41.
19
Time and date reported 8:25 p.m. Time and date S. B. informed ---
4-4-41.
Time and date strike commenced 8:15 p.m. 4-4-41.
By whom reported Loh Wei Zee (陸渭泉).
Trade or profession of strikers Joss Paper & Incense Workers.
Number of strikers 13 Male 13 Female -- Apprentices --
Employer's name, address and business Loh Wei Zee, Proprietor of "Zung Foong"
(成豐) Shop, Lane 51/200, Stone Bridge Road.
Union to which strikers belong Nil.
Cause of strike and demands made by strikers Workers all received loan of $150.00
over one year ago to be paid back $5.00 per month. Loh Wei Zee ignored
previous monthly repayments until 8:15 p.m. 4-4-41., when he informed
staff that repayment would be exacted from 30-4-41.
When did discontent amongst strikers first commence 8:15 p.m. -4-4-41.
What action (if any) did employers take to remedy cause of discontent prior to commencement
of strike Nil.
What action (if any) have the employers taken to meet the demands of the strikers
Postponed monthly instalments of debt until better times and staff
resumed work at 9 p.m. 4-4-41.
Names and addresses of strike leaders (1) Zee Zang Yue (徐長友), 26, Zaushing,
and (2) Ding Ah Hoo (丁阿火), 21, Zaushing, Lane 51/200 Stone Bridge Rd.
Has the strike or its cause any political inspiration Nil.
Meeting places of strikers
Number of persons arrested for offences arising out of strike --
Particulars of literature (if any) circulated relative to strike
Name and address of printer of such circulars
Precautions taken by Police
Investigating Officer Y.H. David B.S.I., and C.D.C. 135.
Subsequent reports on the same strike should be submitted on the Report Forms for general use.

报告时间及日期 晚8时25分。通知特别处时间及日期 ---
1941年4月4日。

报告人 陸渭泉（Loh Wei Zee）。

罢工人数 男13人 女--人 学徒--人
雇主姓名、地址及业务 “成豐”（Zung Foong）店店主陸渭泉，石路桥路51弄200号。

罢工原因及罢工者提出的要求 工人们均在一年多前获得150.00美元贷款，约定每月偿还5.00美元。陸渭泉此前无视每月的还款，直到1941年4月4日晚8时15分，他通知员工将从1941年4月30日起强制扣款偿还。
罢工者不满情绪始于何时 1941年4月4日晚8时15分。
在罢工开始前，雇主为消除不满原因采取了何种行动（如有） 无。
雇主为满足罢工者要求采取了何种行动（如有） 将债务的每月分期付款推迟至情况好转时，员工于1941年4月4日晚9时复工。
罢工领导人姓名及地址 (1) 徐長友（Zee Zang Yue），26岁，曹行（Zaushing）人，及 (2) 丁阿火（Ding Ah Hoo），21岁，曹行（Zaushing）人，住石路桥路51弄200号。
